question: 宁德时代2025年年报的归属于母公司股东的净利润是多少？
answer:
[1] 关键金融指标：归属于母公司股东的净利润（Net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company）

[2] 可能的计算公式：  
归属于母公司股东的净利润 = 净利润 - 少数股东损益  
即：Net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company = Net profit - Minority interests (or Non-controlling interests)

生成查询代码
SELECT 
    fin.ENDDATE AS `报告截止日期`,
    sc.SEC_SNAME AS `股票简称`,
    sc.SEC_CODE AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(fin.F110101/10000, 1) AS `归属于母公司股东的净利润(万)`,
    fin.F110201 AS `扣非净利润(元)`,
    fin.F110401 AS `未分配利润(元)`,
    fin.F111001 AS `基本每股收益(元/股)`,
    fin.F111601 AS `净资产收益率(%)`
FROM 
    VIEW_STK_FIN_IDX fin
    INNER JOIN GET_A_SEC_CODE sc ON fin.COMCODE = sc.COMCODE
WHERE 
    sc.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%宁德时代%'
    AND fin.ENDDATE = '2025-12-31 00:00:00'
    AND fin.ISVALID = 1
    AND sc.ISVALID = 1
ORDER BY fin.ENDDATE DESC
LIMIT 1
